about_the_game:
The climate has reached its breaking point, with increasingly unstable weather patterns leading to more frequent superstorms each season. These storms are causing widespread destruction and instilling fear in the residents of the Valleys. The Project Storm Initiative is seeking recruits to support the community and assist with their mission of reducing the catastrophic impact of nature's fury.

In this solo/co-op action-adventure sim. Begin your storm chasing career as a recruit for the Project Storm Initiative. Encounter, survive, and conquer nature’s most thrilling spectacles, such as menacing EF5 Tornadoes, frightening lightning storms, and typhoons.

Choose between 3 career paths, each with distinctive contacts, equipment, gear, and play styles as well as support from local legends.

  • Rapid Responder,

  • Road Technician,

  • Storm Interceptor,

Contracts can range from rescuing stranded civilians and animals, clearing damaged/debris-laden roads, and deploying weather instruments to weaken, redirect, or neutralise the storm.

Enhance your pursuit with the Storm HQ located in the South of Wyndham Valley. Discover, manage, and expand your first Storm HQ, which offers specialized upgrades and facilities such as storage warehouses, shelters, staff amenities, and garages, all designed to support your ultimate chase against the storm.

Every storm brings a new challenge. Dynamic weather systems create immersive storms and other environmental hazards, shaping gameplay in a reactive environment that demands careful planning and skill to complete contracts

Upgrade, maintain, and customize your dream Storm Chaser Vehicles, Facilities, and Storm HQ with specialized Storm Chaser equipment, technology, and upgrades. 

Your journey starts in the plains of Wyndham Valley. Explore several vast landscapes, sprawling valleys, dense forests, and quaint rural towns. Each map presents unique environmental dangers and hazards for tactical and dynamic gameplay.

Play on your own or join friends online in a co-operative multiplayer adventure. Join forces with your cohort to combine unique player roles and skills to quickly rise through the ranks to become a legendary Storm Chaser.

content_descriptors.notes:
Project Storm includes mild mature content that players should be aware of, such as:

Mild use of profanity and swearing
Insinuated consumption of alcohol and tobacco
The game also features the following interactive elements:

In-game purchases
Online interactions with other players
In-game chat functionality
Please note that while these elements are included to enhance player immersion and experience, they may not be suitable for all audiences. Players sensitive to mild language, references to alcohol or tobacco, or online interactions should exercise discretion when engaging with the game.

name: Project Storm

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X / Intel Core i5-8600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 6 GB VRAM, AMD Radeon RX 580 / Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-8700 3.2 GHz / AMD Ryzen 7 2700 3.2 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB VRAM, AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT / Nvidia GeForce RTX 3070
  • DirectX: Version 12
